name: Grand Canyon Education
outlook:
What Grand Canyon Education says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted diluted income per shareThe diluted EPS guidance includes non-cash amortization of intangible assets net of taxes of $1.6 million, which equates to a $0.06 impact on diluted EPS. Thus, as adjusted, non-GAAP diluted income per share of between $3.63 and $3.67.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted diluted income per shareThe diluted EPS guidance includes non-cash amortization of intangible assets net of taxes of $6.5 million, non-recurring costs net of taxes of $0.8 million and loss on disposal of fixed assets net of taxes of nil which equates to a $0.28 impact on diluted EPS. Thus, as adjusted, non-GAAP diluted income per share of between $10.09 and $10.13.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
